facts.fact: Kenya, South Sudan, Uganda and Rwanda agreed at a ministerial meeting in Nairobi in late April 2026 to move towards a jointly owned regional communication and broadcasting satellite, starting with a feasibility study funded by the four states.
facts.system: Northern Corridor regional communications and broadcasting satellite

facts.fact: Bayobab completed a fibre optic network linking Mombasa in Kenya to Kampala in Uganda in May 2025, per Connecting Africa.

systems.system: Northern Corridor regional communications and broadcasting satellite
systems.owner: Governments of Uganda, Kenya, Rwanda and South Sudan (proposed joint ownership)
